fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a python process calling to the PTY module in order to spawn a pretty tty which could be indicative of potential reverse shell activity.
fields.name: Python Spawning Pretty TTY Via PTY Module
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "/python" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/python2" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/python3") or (tgt.process.image.path contains "/python2." or tgt.process.image.path contains "/python3.")) and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "import pty" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "from pty ") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "spawn"))
